paper_title: ChARM Character-based Act-adaptive Reward Modeling for Advanced   Role-Playing Language Agents
caption: Results of Human Evaluations.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Тази стълбовидна диаграма илюстрира резултатите от човешката оценка на три модела: Claude 3.5, GPT4o и Doubao, като показва техните проценти на победи, равенства и загуби. 
Хоризонталната ос показва скала от 0.0 до 1.0 с интервал от 0.2, като всяка стълба е разделена на три сегмента, съответстващи на Win (розов), Tie (син) и Lose (зелен). 
Вертикалната ос изброява трите модела в азбучен ред без конкретен етикет. 
За Claude 3.5 са показани 32% Win, 44% Tie и 24% Lose. 
За GPT4o са отчетени 56% Win, 18% Tie и 26% Lose. 
За Doubao са отчетени 42% Win, 36% Tie и 22% Lose. 
Всеки модел има различни проценти за Win, Tie и Lose, като не се наблюдава специфично групиране или подреждане на стълбите освен стандартната им подредба по име на модела.
model_annotations.English: The chart illustrates the results of human evaluations for three entities: Claude3.5, GPT4o, and Doubao, comparing their "Win", "Tie", and "Lose" outcomes. The vertical axis contains the categories, listing the three entities in the order of Claude3.5, GPT4o, and Doubao. The horizontal axis represents the proportion of outcomes, labeled with a scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 in intervals of 0.2. Each entity is represented by a stacked bar, divided into three segments: "Win" (pink), "Tie" (blue), and "Lose" (green). The "Win" segment for Claude3.5 is approximately 32.0% long, followed by "Tie" at 44.0%, and "Lose" at 24.0%. For GPT4o, "Win" is the longest at 56.0%, "Tie" is 18.0%, and "Lose" is 26.0%. Doubao's segments are 42.0% for "Win", 36.0% for "Tie", and 22.0% for "Lose". The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized. The chart provides a clear visual representation of the relative proportions of "Win", "Tie", and "Lose" outcomes for each entity.
model_annotations.German: Dieses Balkendiagramm zeigt die Ergebnisse von menschlichen Bewertungen, dargestellt durch die prozentuale Verteilung von "Win", "Tie" und "Lose" für drei verschiedene Modelle: Claude3.5, GPT4o und Doubao. Die y-Achse listet die Modellnamen auf, während die x-Achse die prozentuale Skala von 0,0 bis 1,0 mit einem Intervall von 0,2 zeigt. Jeder Balken ist in drei Segmente unterteilt, die mit "Win" (rosa), "Tie" (blau) und "Lose" (grün) beschriftet sind. Die Balken für Claude3.5 zeigen Werte von 32,0% für Win, 44,0% für Tie und 24,0% für Lose. Der höchste Balken ist GPT4o mit 56,0% für Win, 18,0% für Tie und 26,0% für Lose. Der Balken für Doubao zeigt 42,0% für Win, 36,0% für Tie und 22,0% für Lose. Die Balken sind nicht nach einer bestimmten Ordnung sortiert und es gibt keine Hervorhebung einzelner Balken.
